newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Fogade sells 2 seats on Caracas bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Fogade sells 2 seats on Caracas bolsa.

text.p: Venezuelan state deposits guarantee fund Fogade auctioned two seats on the Caracas stock exchange for over $400,000 each on Thursday, Fogade said.

Venezuelan brokers Interbursa posted a winning bid of 192.5 million bolivars ($404,000) for seat number 12, while Serfincorp brokers paid 207.5 million bolivars ($437,000) for seat number 33. The bids more than doubled Fogade's asking base price of 76.5 million bolivars ($165,000).
The auction was part of Fogade's ongoing sale of assets used to back financial guarantees offered by the state to troubled banks during the country's 1994-5 banking crisis.
